title: DisableAll - RefCollectionAlias
content:
Member of: RefCollectionAlias Script Calls DisableNoWait on all the references in the collection. Syntax: Function DisableAll(bool bFadeOut = false) Parameters: - bFadeOut: Whether to fade out or not Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Disable all the items in the collection Stage1Items.DisableAll()
; Disable all the items with fading Ghosts.DisableAll(true) Notes: Because this uses DisableNoWait, the references will not necessarily have faded or been disabled by the time this function returns. See Also: - RefCollectionAlias Script - DisableNoWait - ObjectReference
